title: A Cover for the Border
author: Felix Voss
blurb: Sable Fairweather, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
